lines: I’ll inspect the pinned treams-rs source and current Advect implementation, then compare the dispatch options and adapter limits. This will remain a read-only design investigation, independent of release work.
Left out: 2 commands that read the agent's own notes.

The checkouts match both supplied revisions. I’m applying a skill’s simplicity guidance to the design review. The source has separate NumPy and autodiff physics layers, so the key question is where dispatch can reuse the existing derivative path before NumPy conversion removes tracing information.

Type-based selection looks feasible, but selecting only at constructors would leave a gap: a traced sphere could use the framework adapter while a constant incident wave remains a NumPy object, and those objects do not currently compose. A useful transparent design needs a bounded rule for promoting such constants, or an explicit backend choice covering the whole calculation.
